payout_value_note: flat $200 Premier Plus Checking new-account bonus, paid as two $100 deposits on day 61
payout_quote: Earn a $200 New Premier Plus Checking Account Bonus. Set up a $250 or more qualifying ACH direct deposit, enroll in eStatements, and make 10 debit card point-of-sale transactions within the first 60 days. Two $100 bonus deposits will be made on day 61.
steps: Open a new Premier Plus Checking account online at premieramerica.com (or in a branch); new accounts only.
Fund the $25 Premier Plus opening share and $1 credit union membership share.
Within the first 60 days: (a) have at least one qualifying ACH direct deposit of $250 or more post, (b) enroll in eStatements, and (c) make 10 or more debit card point-of-sale transactions.
Keep the account open and in good standing through day 61.
Receive two $100 bonus deposits on day 61.
catches: $25 opening share + $1 membership share required to open (refundable).
Must not have received a bonus for opening or converting a checking account within the past 24 months; existing or converted checking accounts are excluded.
Qualifying ACH direct deposit is $250 or more in a single deposit; P2P/mobile check deposits do not qualify.
All three actions (ACH DD, eStatements, 10 debit POS transactions) required within the first 60 days.
Bonus paid as two $100 deposits on day 61; account must be open and in good standing at payout.
Bonus reported on IRS Form 1099; recipient pays taxes.
Offer may be withdrawn or ended without notice - no stated expiry date.
biggest_catch: All three requirements (a single $250+ ACH direct deposit, eStatements enrollment, AND 10 debit card POS transactions) must be completed within the first 60 days, and members who received a checking bonus within the past 24 months are ineligible - the offer can also end without notice.
eligibility: New Premier Plus Checking members who have not received a checking account opening/converting bonus within the past 24 months. Premier America Credit Union field of membership (California residents primarily; verify online).
timing: Two $100 bonus deposits on day 61 after meeting all requirements. No stated expiry date; offer subject to end without notice.
